actuator_targets_and_estimates.architecture: Spring-closed pull solenoid, matched pressure areas, closed magnetic circuit with flow-through flux spiders and an anti-remanence stop.
actuator_targets_and_estimates.driver: Current-regulated peak and hold with an enclosure-side boost rail; power off releases the return spring.
actuator_targets_and_estimates.qualification: Magnetic finite-element analysis, seal friction, force versus stroke and temperature, closure, carbonation and life remain engineering work.

hydraulic_targets_and_estimates.volume_scope: Outlet bore, small wet balance chamber, hollow stem and rod-gland clearance. Seal grooves and films are not included. The armature and return spring occupy a separate dry chamber.

materials_and_process.bundle: Reinforced beverage hose, smaller separate flavor and drain lines, flexible conductors, a thin insulating layer and continuous protective sleeve.
materials_and_process.coil: Custom winding on an insulated bobbin, protected inside its magnetic return yoke.
materials_and_process.dynamic_seals: Food-contact compound to be specified; low-friction piston seal and a separate low-pressure rod seal.
materials_and_process.flux_bridges: Passivated magnetic stainless, with axial water passages and sealed interfaces to the dry armature bore.
materials_and_process.inlet: Integral angled barb and factory crimp; no exposed disconnect at the docking seam.
materials_and_process.wet_pressure_tubes_and_seat: Precision-turned and laser-joined stainless steel; smooth outlet seat.

purpose: This record owns the custom valve's geometry and first-order design budgets for the slim pull-out faucet.
reference_scope: The pressure-balancing architecture is established. The reference does not validate this geometry, food service, magnetic design or performance.
state: Proposed end-state mechanism and packaging; performance values below are requirements or first-order estimates, not qualified hardware ratings.
